simple.meaning: תַּרְשִׁישׁ (tarshîysh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a gem, perhaps the topaz.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:20. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּרְשִׁישׁ (H8658) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תַּרְשִׁישׁ (tarshîysh) / H8658 is traced through Exodus 28:20, Exodus 39:13, Song of Songs 5:14, Ezekiel 1:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

timeline.evidenceText: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

definitions.full: H8658. tarshish I. תַּרְשִׁישׁ noun masculine a precious stone , perhaps yellow jasper , or other gold-coloured stone ( ᵐ5 L Exod 28:20 ; 39:13 χρυσόλιθοχ , so Jos Ant. iii. 7 , 5 [168], see Petrie Hast. DB STONES, PRECIOUS Myres Ency. Bib. ID. § 17 Dr Dan 10:6 ); — ת ׳כְּעֵין Ezek 1:6 ; ת אֵבֶן ׳כְּעֵין 10:9 ; in list of gems 28:13 ; Exod 28:20 ; 39:13 ; in simile of resplendent body Dan 10:6 , compare Song 5:14 .
